title: Buchanan's 30-year database scoring remote viewers' accuracy

tellings.quote: So when I started what 30 years ago was a database that I've kept ever since of viewers work

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who worked in remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe distant places or things using only the mind, says that about 30 years ago he started a database of remote viewers' work. He says he has kept it ever since to score how accurate each viewer turns out to be, which would give a record of how well the method works if it holds up.
